business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Virgin Polyethylene and Polypropylene Granules

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code) with mandatory notarial intervention for certain corporate acts and full transposition of EU AML/CFT Directives
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–[UBO home country] Bilateral Investment Treaties as confirmed after UBO jurisdiction identification; France has over 100 active BITs
France–[UBO home country] Double Taxation Treaties under the OECD Model; France maintains a network of over 120 DTAAs
Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures (BEPS MLI), ratified by France on 31 January 2020
EU internal market framework: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Articles 49 and 63 on freedom of establishment and free movement of capital

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, Articles L.561-1 to L.561-50; Décret n° 2017-1094 du 5 juin 2017 (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs); Décret n° 2021-1034 du 4 août 2021 (implementation of CJEU judgments on public access); Règlement (UE) 2015/847 on information accompanying transfers of funds; Code de commerce, Articles R.123-166 to R.123-169; Loi n° 2020-1672 du 22 décembre 2020.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — French beneficial owner register is not openly public; access is strictly reserved to tax authorities, judicial authorities, TRACFIN, and obliged financial-sector professionals on a legitimate-interest and AML duty basis.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Registration and Certificate of Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Registry of Commerce of the country of origin of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; if the issuing state is not an Apostille Convention signatory, full Consular Legalization by the French Embassy/Consulate with prior legalization at the foreign Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for the authorized representative (gérant nominee) of the SARL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Hague jurisdictions, complete Consular Legalization chain at the French Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of every natural person qualified as a French-law beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the jurisdiction of nationality, Notary Public, or French Consular section
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the French Embassy/Consulate in the country of issuance; notarization by the foreign notary is condition precedent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal Record Extract or equivalent police clearance certificate for the first gérant if not French resident
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National criminal record authority of the manager's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or full Consular Legalization if the state is non-Apostille signatory; certified French translation is mandatory

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers, authorized signatories, and commercial counterparties against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, and France's national financial sanctions measures. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) are screened in accordance with Article L.561-10 of the Code monétaire et financier and FATF Recommendation 12. Any positive match triggers enhanced CDD, source-of-wealth documentation, and STR filing to Tracfin.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); commercial registry consultation portal: Infogreffe.fr; National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI) for trademark/name conflict search
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be drafted in Latin characters; the name must be in French or contain a French translation for any foreign-language element. Non-Latin script trade names must be transliterated into Latin characters and accompanied by a certified French translation in the articles of association. The legal form 'SARL' and share capital amount must appear in or immediately after the name on all formal documents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Although French law does not provide a statutory name-reservation system equivalent to trademark registration, a founder may request from the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce an 'attestation de non-déposition de nom' or rely on the INPI pre-registration search; such credentials are accepted for a conventional 30-day window and may be renewed. If the Guichet Unique or the Greffe rejects the name at the incorporation stage, the applicant must file a written objection with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the intended registered office within 15 days from notification; the objection is then submitted to the presiding judge (juge commis) for review. In parallel, the applicant may restructure the name by adding a distinctive, non-descriptive token and submit another formalities file.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices through an approved domiciliation company are legally permissible for a wholesale petrochemical trading SARL under Articles L.123-16 and R.123-138 to R.123-140 of the Code de commerce. The domiciliation address must be a genuine commercial address, with access to all correspondence and statutory documents; but KYC-AML departments of French banks, when faced with medium-risk SWIFT/Remittance-based petrochemical trade, will almost always require a physical executive office and a resident representative, particularly for irrevocable letter of credit operations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical inspection at the registered office is approximately 5% to 10% per fiscal year when the office is a professional domiciliation; if the SARL operates from a non-domiciliation independent site, the probability rises to 15% to 25% due to DGFiP and URSSAF inspection priorities in wholesale chemical distribution. Additionally, there is a 40% probability of a pre-bank KYC site visit before activation of Swift LC facilities for bulk petrochemical polymers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO and AML due diligence file preparation, PEP and sanctions screening of all foreign shareholders and beneficial owners
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Avocat / Compliance advisor retained by the founders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: 2-3 hours of French corporate compliance counsel at €350-€450 per hour

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of SARL Articles of Association and shareholder deed under French law
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French Avocat / Notaire if statutory notarization is voluntarily elected
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: €1,000 to €1,500 flat fee for non-notarial professional statutory drafting

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability review, INPI pre-search and optional Greffe non-deposit certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official INPI fee for online trademark search and registry certificate tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the legal notice (avis de constitution) in a French legal gazette
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales approved by the prefecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for legal-announcement insertion, adjusted by number of compulsory mentions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing of the incorporation file through the Guichet Unique and registration at the RCS (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed tariff fixed by the Minister of Justice order for RCS registration of a SARL

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing and regularisation of the beneficial owner declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / DGFiP
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed administrative tariff for the register des bénéficiaires effectifs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostilles and consular legalization of foreign corporate registration and personal identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of foreign state / French Consulate / designated apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular and apostille fee schedules for four documents plus courier and handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translation of foreign corporate certificates, passport copies, powers of attorney and criminal records extracts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Court-certified translator (Expert près la Cour d'Appel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Judicial tariff schedule for certified translation, typically €0.20 to €0.35 per French word plus certification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation contract through an approved commercial domiciliation company for the first fiscal year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Domiciliation company approved under Article R.123-140 of Code de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate: €720 to €900 per year for commercial domiciliation and mail handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French bank KYC preparation, pre-incorporation interview coaching and AML onboarding advisory
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: €350 to €500 fixed advisory fee for medium-risk trading entity

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-29 (SARL); Civil Code Article 1832 et seq.; Order No. 2021-1189 and Decree No. 2023-216 establishing the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry of the Commercial Court having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office), exclusively reachable through the national Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at guichet.entreprise.fr
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de personne morale (electronic incorporation formality) accompanied by the fully executed Statuts de la Société, filed via the Guichet Unique portal and transmitted to the Greffe for legal review and issuance of the Kbis extract
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital (SARL may be formed with EUR 1). At least one-fifth (20%) of cash quotas must be paid up at subscription and the balance within five years. All cash contributions must be deposited to a blocked escrow account with a licensed French bank, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, and remain frozen until the Kbis is issued. In-kind contributions exceeding EUR 30,000 in value or more than half of the share capital require a statutory contribution auditor (commissaire aux apports).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) the shareholders approve the Articles of Association in full, adopt the share capital of EUR [●] divided into [●] equal parts sociales, and confirm the subscription of cash contributions and their deposit with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; (2) the registered office is fixed at [●], Paris; (3) [●] is appointed as Gérant of the company with full powers of administration within the corporate object; (4) the Gérant is authorized to execute the incorporation filing, publish the legal notice, and open the company's corporate bank account; and (5) all pre-incorporation acts and expenses are ratified and taken over by the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Articles of Association and Appointment Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate legal counsel and all shareholders acting in private capacity (notarization optional for SARL); final submission routed later through the Guichet Unique portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the Statuts including corporate name, registered office address, corporate object limited to wholesale distribution of virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules, share capital structure, Gérant identity and powers, and duration (max 99 years). Have each shareholder sign the Statuts and countersign the written acceptance of office by the proposed Gérant. Attach the Gérant's declaration of non-conviction (bulletin n°3) and specimen identity documents. Verify SOFICO/INPI name availability and reserve the company name if required.
required_dossiers: Executed Statuts de la Société
Written acceptance of office by the Gérant
Declarations de non-condamnation (bulletin n°3) for the Gérant
Passports or national identity cards of all shareholders
Proof of registered office availability or project
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name or clauses are queried or rejected by the registry, execute a rectificative avenant to the Statuts and re-submit the corrected deed before initiating the formality; reserve an alternate corporate name if the INPI search shows a conflicting prior mark.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital into a Blocked Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations or any licensed French bank or notary acting as depositaire des fonds
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional (non-interest-bearing) blocked deposit account held in the name of the company-in-formation, transfer the full subscribed cash contributions, and obtain the official attestation de dépôt des fonds listing the depositary, the amount, and the subscriber details. If in-kind contributions are made, appoint the commissaire aux apports to value the assets and annex the valuation report to the Statuts.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening forms and beneficial ownership declarations
Statuts project or extract detailing the capital subscription table
Identity documents of the legal representative
Appointment order of the commissaire aux apports (for in-kind contributions, if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected depositary rejects the file due to incomplete documentation, remedy the deficiencies within two business days or choose an alternate licensed bank; the capital remains fungible and may be transferred to a second depositary without dissolution of the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Constitution Notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An authorized Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) competent for the department of the registered office (Paris publication for a Paris siège social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and publish the mandatory avis de constitution containing the corporate name, legal form (SARL), share capital amount, registered office address, corporate object, company duration, names of the Gérant(s), and the RCS city where registration will be sought. Obtain the original justificatif de parution issued by the gazette, with the attestation being transmitted to the registry within the statutory timeline.
required_dossiers: Project of Statuts
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (or notarial certificate)
Identity and address of the Gérant
Completed publication questionnaire of the JAL
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL returns the notice for drafting errors, correct the wording and republish within the same week; the registry counts from the actual publication date, so a fresh justificatif de parution must be obtained to avoid a formal incompleteness notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submitting the Incorporation Dossier to the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (guichet.entreprise.fr), operated by INPI and relayed to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for legal control
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic declaration of creation of a legal person, select the SARL legal form and the ISIC 4669 / wholesale distribution of plastic granules activity, and upload all scanned originals: executed Statuts, deposit certificate or notarial certificate, justificatif de parution, certificate of non-conviction of the Gérant, and proof of enjoyment of the registered premises (lease, title deed, or written authorization of the owner). Pay the portal processing fee and await the automated transmission to the Greffe; the Registry performs the legal conformity check and issues the RCS registration and Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Executed Statuts (uploaded PDF)
Attestation de dépôt des fonds or notarial certificate of the capital deposit
Justificatif de parution from the JAL
Bulletin n°3 of the Gérant
Justificatif de jouissance des locaux (lease or owner's authorization)
Identity documents of shareholders and Gérant
Completed electronic formality on the Guichet Unique portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon a demande de complément (request for further information), cure the cited irregularity through the Guichet Unique within the imperative 15-business-day window; if the Greffe issues a final refusal, file a summary petition (référé) before the president of the competent tribunal de commerce to compel registration, or restart the formality after correcting the deficiencies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (issuance of SIREN/SIRET), Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Kbis issuance), and the company's Gérant for internal governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Kbis and SIREN/SIRET numbers, open the definitive corporate bank account, unfreeze the blocked capital with the depositary, execute the minutes of the first Gérant decisions (designation of authorized signatories, fix of banking mandate, adoption of accounting and VAT registration settings), and file the required VAT and corporate income tax election letters. Establish the registre des décisions des associés, publish the legal details on commercial documents, and implement the internal trade-based compliance manual (Know-Your-Counterparty, LC documentation review, and sanctions screening) consistent with the medium-risk AML classification.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract (original)
Company incorporation and capital deposit records
Minutes of the first Gérant decisions
Bank account opening package for the definitive accounts
Lease agreement of the registered premises
VAT registration and tax election forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If INSEE or the tax authorities flag any data mismatch in the SIREN/SIRET attribution, transmit the Kbis and corrected corporate data to the competent local business tax office (SIE) and request a rectification; if the bank blocks the definitive account opening, supplement the beneficial owner file and re-submit the Kbis and business plan extracts.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL), Inspection des Installations Classées (intervention only if on-site polymer storage triggers ICPE thresholds)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — wholesale trading and distribution of polymer granules is not a licensed activity in France. A Convention de roulement under the ICPE declaratory regime (rubrique 1510, entrepôts couverts) applies only if the covered warehouse stores more than 500 tonnes of combustible polymer materials.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique and DREAL (ICPE inspection); Agence de l'Environnement et de la Maîtrise de l'Énergie (ADEME) for waste and circular-economy reporting obligations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a formal environmental impact assessment for a pure trading and warehousing activity storing below 500 tonnes of polymer granules; a simple déclaration (D-regime) with the DREAL and a recepisse may be required if the covered warehouse storage threshold under ICPE rubrique 1510 is exceeded, subject to predefined sectoral performance requirements.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emissions are generated since the activity involves no transformation. Compliance thresholds: municipal industrial wastewater admission limits (typical BOD5 800 mg/L, COD 2,000 mg/L, TSS 600 mg/L, pH 6.5-8.5, temperature below 30°C); zero-loss containment of plastic pellets to prevent release into stormwater; obligation to obtain Safety Data Sheets and comply with EU REACH/CLP registration and classification rules for polyethylene and polypropylene granules; waste handling under Code de l'environnement Articles R.541-1 et seq. with European Waste Code 07 02 13; annual plastic packaging reporting for the French extension-of-producer-responsibility scheme where applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: maintenance of a registre de sécurité, portable extinguishers, emergency exits, and a fire safety visit by the municipal commission de sécurité if the premises qualify as accessibles au public; electrical installations verified per Code du travail Article R.4224-17 with a conformity certificate; structural verification of storage racking and floors for the mechanical load of bagged polymer granules; occupational health clearance through the company's service de prévention et de santé au travail, including an initial medical visit for personnel and the display of emergency instructions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) — Portal: impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign entity without a French permanent establishment: appoint an accredited VAT tax representative (unless established in the EU), submit the VAT registration application (cerfa n° 13703) to the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) of the tax representative's local office, and obtain a SIRET/SIREN number and the French intra-Community VAT number. For a domestically established SARL: file incorporation with the Centre de Formalités des Entreprises (CFE), receive a Kbis extract and SIREN/SIRET, and obtain the VAT number automatically from the DGFIP. In cross-border cases, the VAT number is requested via form n° 1190 through the DGFIP's Service de la TVA; an online application and digital filing are mandatory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SARL may elect to be treated as fiscally transparent (option pour le régime des sociétés de personnes / impôt sur le revenu) for a five-year period if it meets the statutory conditions, including not exceeding 50 shareholders and not being listed. This election is available under Article 239 bis AA and 239 bis AB of the French General Tax Code. France does not operate a pure check-the-box election; separate anti-hybrid rules under ATAD require the neutralization of mismatches arising from hybrid entities or instruments. The default for a commercial SARL is entity-level corporate income tax, and no other broad entity classification election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for non-established B2B suppliers (first euro of taxable supply in France triggers registration); domestic small-business franchise threshold: EUR 85,000 annual turnover for goods; EU distance-selling threshold for B2C cross-border trade: EUR 10,000 (for remote sales from another EU state).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates structured e-invoicing for B2B transactions under the 2024/2026 roadmap (Article 289 CGI and implementing decree 2022-1298). E-invoices must be transmitted via the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or an accredited partner platform (PDP) using structured data formats (UBL, Factur-X) through approved APIs. Cross-currency transactions and exports require e-reporting to the DGFIP. No traditional physical digital stamp is used; however, export goods must be electronically cleared via the DELTA-X customs declaration system operating within the Union Customs Code framework.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Supplies of goods physically exported outside the European Union are zero-rated for French VAT under Article 262-0 of the General Tax Code, provided the goods are ground out of France within 3 months of despatch and the exporter retains full documentary proof of exportation. The ex-warehouse and final export shipment are supported by the customs export declaration. Offshore B2B services supplied to a non-EU client are deemed to be supplied in the client's country under the place-of-supply rule (Article 259-1 CGI) and therefore fall outside the scope of French VAT; when required, the 0% rate or exemption is claimed on the VAT return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane / DAU)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Avis de crédit / Certificat de rapatriement)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Unsubstantiated or fraudulent export zero-rating results in the immediate collection of French VAT at 20%, plus late-payment interest (0.20% per month), and penalties. Negligent error: 40% of the tax due; serious misconduct: 80%; intentional fraud: 100%. The tax authority may claw back VAT for up to six years (ten years for fraud). Criminal penalties under Article 1741 CGI may be imposed for deliberate falsification of export evidence, including imprisonment and monetary fines. Customs and exchange-control offices also review the inward remittance certificate; failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days triggers customs penalties and potential suspension of export zero-rating privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), operating within the Eurosystem of the European Central Bank; foreign-financial-relations oversight and balance-of-payments statistical coordination are also exercised by the Direction Générale du Trésor and the Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies the EU Treaty free movement of capital regime (Article 63 TFEU) and therefore maintains full current-account and capital-account convertibility for euro-denominated and major foreign-currency operations. There is no general exchange-control licensing requirement for remittances of profit, dividends, or trade-related payments. Profit remittance is subject to French corporate formalities rather than FX control: the SARL must document distributable reserves through approved annual accounts and a shareholder capital resolution; French withholding tax may apply to non-resident shareholders unless reduced by an applicable double-tax treaty, by the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive in an intra-EU context, or through other domestic exemptions. For non-EU investments, prior French foreign-investment authorisation is triggered only for listed sensitive or national-security sectors; wholesale petrochemical polymer distribution is not ordinarily listed, but the bank will still verify legal substance, source of funds, and the economic purpose of each inbound transfer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts in France. As a Eurozone member, France permits exporters to receive and retain foreign-currency proceeds, to hold them in multicurrency accounts, or to convert them at market rates without central bank approval. Export-related cross-border financial flows must nevertheless be supported by underlying commercial documentation and may be subject to Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting requirements. All payments must include accurate originator and beneficiary data under Regulation (EU) 2015/847, and the sanctioned party screening obligations of the applicable French and EU regulations remain applicable.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account in EUR/USD; Capital Escrow Account; Trade Services sub-limits
Operational Settlement Account; Receivables and Payables Clearing Account
Commodity Trade Finance Account; Documentary Credit and Guarantee Account; Escrow Account
Domestic Operational Account; SEPA Clearing Account
Multicurrency Operational Account; Cross-Border Settlement and Treasury Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low for offshore digital electronic money institutions. Under the EU PSD2 and AML/CFT framework, a French ACPR-licensed electronic money institution may offer payment accounts and payment initiation services through the Single Euro Payments Area passporting regime, but such providers generally cannot offer documentary credits, supply-chain finance guarantees, or full SWIFT trade-clearing rails that are expected for bulk petrochemical polymer settlements. An offshore non-EU EMI would require separate registration or a local branch/model in France and is likely to be rejected as a primary treasury partner because of regulatory, sanctions, and correspondent-banking constraints. The recommended structure is a top-tier French or EU commercial bank as principal treasury counterparty, optionally complemented by a narrow-purpose ACPR-registered payment institution for low-value collection flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French AML/KYC law permits remote client identification using compliant video-identification solutions under Article R.561-16 of the French Monetary and Financial Code, but banks are not legally obliged to accept remote-only onboarding. For an ISIC 4669 petrochemical wholesale trader classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced, the chief compliance officer and front-office RMs typically require a face-to-face interview or an equivalent secure video meeting with the legal representative, the signatories on the account, and the natural-person ultimate beneficial owners. Physical presence of non-resident directors at a French branch significantly improves viability. Remote opening may be legally possible when directors have strong local substance, complete electronic KYC documentation, and a model that permits authenticated identity verification; however, if the bank categorises the customer as high-risk due to ownership or counterparty geography, an in-person interview at the bank premises will normally be mandated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque multi-tier ownership or incomplete identification of natural-person ultimate beneficial owners of the petrochemical trading entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the French Kbis extract; constitutional act and amended articles of association; register of members and share transfer records; statutory UBO declaration filed with the RCS; detailed group structure chart; passport copies and proof-of-address for each UBO; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements for inbound shareholders; notarised corporate resolutions appointing directors and account signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening hits on counterparties, flagged shipping routes, vessels, or polymer cargo origins
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative media and OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening reports; counterparty KYC packs and trade compliance certificates; signed commercial contract with full Incoterms; bills of lading; certificates of origin; customs declarations; cargo inspection certificates; vessel ownership and tracking documentation; shipping route analysis; end-customer undertakings and anti-diversion warranty letters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Documentary letter-of-credit presentation discrepancies or unexpected settlement requests inconsistent with underlying commodity trade flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full text of the irrevocable LC and any confirmations; chronological presentation records; supplier/vendor registration file; commercial invoice; full-set clean-on-board bills of lading; packing list; certificate of origin; quantity and quality certificates; insurance policy; MT799 or MT103 documentary evidence; reconciliation with the corporate ERP ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large, high-frequency cross-border credit and debit wires involving high-risk jurisdictions or unexplained third-party payment chains
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying purchase and sales agreements with defined payment terms, currencies, and settlement conditions; board-approved treasury and liquidity policy; historical payment-pattern file; bank purpose-code mapping and explanatory memorandum; invoice-to-payment reconciliation; audit trail of the originated payment orders; confirmation of legal and tax compliance for the expressed purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-party back-to-back petrochemical trades with indirect settlement or invoice reassignment
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Chain-of-title documentation covering each transfer of ownership; direct contractual links between the SARL and each immediate counterparty; assignment or novation agreements; proof of actual economic activity such as warehouse receipts, terminal storage certificates, or freight forwarding records; Swiss or other intermediate-entity ownership and substance evidence; tax and AML risk assessment signed by the compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound routing must be executed through SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers or MT202 bank-to-bank transfers, depending on whether the beneficiary is the SARL directly or an intermediary nostro account. The payment originator must include under Regulation (EU) 2015/847 the full name, address, account number, and identifier of the originator; the SARL as beneficiary must provide its OECD Legal Entity Identifier or Kbis registration data and a clear purpose description. For a shareholder capital contribution, the corporate documentation should include a notarised or signed capital-increase deliberation, proof of deposit of funds with the bank where required, and registration updates at the RCS if the registered capital is amended. For a shareholder current-account advance, the governing resolution should authorise the advance and define its interest, maturity, and repayment terms. The bank will require a transfer-purpose code from its digital banking menu indicating 'capital contribution', 'shareholder advance/current account', or 'trade payment', and the SARL must be prepared to submit the underlying contract or board resolution for compliance review. French foreign direct investment authorisation is generally not required for petrochemical polymer wholesale trading, but a non-EU investor should nonetheless conduct a pre-filing legal check under Article R.151-2 of the Monetary and Financial Code to confirm the activity does not fall within a sensitive sector. Any statistical balance-of-payments declaration required by Banque de France must be made through the receiving intermediary bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements should be cleared via SWIFT MT103 for direct customer trades, MT202 for bank-level nostro disbursements, and commercial documentary credits for structured supply-chain settlement. The standard rail for polymer imports is an irrevocable letter of credit issued via SWIFT MT700, amended through MT707 as necessary, and settled at sight or by negotiation/acceptance upon presentation of compliant documents. Required documentary packages generally include a signed commercial invoice, full-set clean-on-board bills of lading issued to the order of the bank or the SARL, packing list, certificate of origin, inspection certificate, and insurance certificate. For euro-denominated low-value payments, the SEPA Credit Transfer rail is available; for high-value euro urgency, TARGET2 is the definitive clearing system. All outbound transactions must be tracked through SWIFT gpi with a unique end-to-end transaction reference, and the SARL must maintain a reconciliation file matching each MT103/MT202 or LC settlement to the corresponding purchase order and supplier invoice.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX forwards in EUR/USD executed under ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or French banking master agreement standard terms
Cross-currency swaps between EUR and USD, including floating-to-fixed and fixed-to-fixed streams, subject to EMIR margining and clearing thresholds

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for defined non-convertible emerging-market currencies, permitted only where the underlying trade exposure is genuine and the French bank lawfully transacts under EU sanctions and FX regulations; EUR/USD NDFs are discouraged because the underlying is freely deliverable
Plain-vanilla EUR/USD currency options for hedging commodity-price and settlement-window exposure, subject to board-approved treasury policy
Embedded FX forwards in documentary letter-of-credit and supplier financing arrangements where the bank's trade finance desk underwrites the currency conversion at maturity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual approval of statutory accounts and discharge of the gérant (ordinary decision of shareholders)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: None (internal corporate act): evidence retained in the statutory minutes book and made available to the commercial registry upon demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than six months after fiscal-year end; court may extend on petition (Code de commerce art. L223-26)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or missing approval prevents lawful deposit of annual accounts and exposes the gérant to civil liability; any interested person or the Public Prosecutor may seek a court order compelling the meeting/injunction under penalty (astreinte).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual statutory accounts (balance sheet, income statement, notes, management report, auditor's report if appointed) with the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / INPI Guichet unique (Registre national des entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholders' approval and in any event within seven months after fiscal-year end; for a 31 December year-end, standard filing date is 31 July absent extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: After formal notice, the commercial court may impose a coercive injunction (astreinte) and an amende civile; repeated non-filing permits the registry's administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS, thereby removing corporate legal validity against third parties and triggering director liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale: forms 2065-SD and annexes including balance sheet and result schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP) – professional online filing via impots.gouv.fr
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December fiscal-year end: second business day after 1 May; for other fiscal-year ends: within three months after fiscal-year close (Code général des impôts art. 223)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing interest of 0.20% per month and automatic 5% late-filing penalty of the underlying tax; penalties may reach 40% in cases of intentional bad faith; no administrative strike-off but tax authorities may issue a formal tax assessment and enforce sequestration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner (bénéficiaire effectif) declaration and annual confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / INPI RNE (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with annual accounts filing for annual confirmation; if a share transfer or any control change occurs, an updated declaration must be filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Violation of the anti-money-laundering beneficial owner register rules is punishable by up to six months' imprisonment and EUR 37,500 fine for individuals, with corporate penalties up to five times that amount; registry filings may be blocked until the declaration is made.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when at least two of three thresholds are exceeded at the balance-sheet date: balance-sheet total over EUR 4,000,000, net turnover (excl. VAT) over EUR 8,000,000, or average workforce over 50 employees. Appointment is also mandatory upon request of shareholders representing at least one-tenth of the capital or under applicable group/control circumstances (Code de commerce, L.223-35, L.823-1, D.223-2).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général – ANC Règlement No. 2014-03) as codified in Code de commerce articles L.123-12 to L.123-22; IFRS is optional only for consolidated financial statements and is not permitted for the statutory entity accounts of a SARL.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The legal representative must confirm, at least annually in the annual RCS filing, the exactness and integrity of beneficial-owner data previously declared. Any shareholding transfer or other fact changing the ultimate beneficial owner or the nature/percentage of control obliges the SARL to file a revised beneficial owner declaration with the commercial registry within 30 days; the register of members must also record the transfer, and the updated shareholding schedule is then cross-checked with the RBE declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des associés (Register of Members) including share-transfer movements, with names and shareholding of each member
Registre des décisions et procès-verbaux (Minute Book) covering all shareholders' ordinary and extraordinary decisions and manager minutes
Registre des gérants / legal representative records (Register of Directors/Gérants) and RCS identity filings for current and former managers

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400–1,500 per year depending on registered-office type and whether a corporate services agent includes annual RCS deposit and book-keeping coordination
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 9,000–25,000 for a wholesale petrochemical distribution SARL; higher if transfer-pricing documentation, multi-entity, or EUR/USD bank compliance and consolidated audit requirements apply

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of annual taxable income for qualifying small companies (turnover not exceeding EUR 10,000,000, fully paid-up share capital, and at least 75% held by natural persons); research tax credit (CIR) at 30% of qualified expenses up to EUR 100,000,000 per annum and innovation tax credit (CII) at 20% up to EUR 400,000 where the petrochemical trader performs eligible R&D or product adaptation in France; foreign tax credit relief for effectively taxed foreign-source income; the 3.3% social surcharge on corporate income tax applies only where the gross corporate tax exceeds EUR 763,000 after an annual turnover threshold of EUR 7,630,000.
